title: What Sales Teams Build with AI (Without a Single Developer)
summary: Sales reps spend 60% of their time on non-selling tasks. Here's how sales teams build custom ROI calculators, pipeline dashboards, and commission trackers with AI—in hours, not sprints.
body_markdown: Yes, through API integration. Blink apps can pull data from Salesforce, HubSpot, and any tool with a REST API. You describe the integration you need and Blink builds the connector. Common integrations — Salesforce opportunity data, HubSpot deal stages — typically take under an hour to wire up.
